---
title: "Technology Geopolitics"
description: "Technology contestation, AI geopolitics, techno-strategic autonomy, and digital policy"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

Technology has become the primary arena of great power competition. I research how technology interdependencies shape geopolitics, why techno-strategic autonomy is often counterproductive, and what a more effective technology strategy for India and other middle powers looks like.

::: {.topic-hero}
::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Core idea

India should spearhead an [Open Technology Maitri](../big-ideas.html) — a principled alliance of developing countries to promote open-source software, open standards, open hardware, and interoperability as safeguards for techno-strategic autonomy.
:::

::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Directory

The [AI for Public Policy Directory](https://aipublicpolicy.org) is a searchable catalogue of AI tools, dashboards, and projects built for public policy.
:::
